einzeiler: Revisiting Alexis de Tocqueville's historic route across America for a new podcast.
kurzfassung: John Priddo, the US editor for The Economist, retraces the nine-month journey of Alexis de Tocqueville to examine the state of American democracy. Traveling across the country, he speaks with diverse Americans from all walks of life to understand how the nation has changed. The new podcast explores whether Tocqueville's insights still hold true as the United States approaches its 250th anniversary.
stichpunkte: Alexis de Tocqueville traveled to America in 1831 to study its unique society without a monarch.
He documented his nine-month road trip in 14 notebooks, leading to the book Democracy in America.
John Priddo views Tocqueville's work as the most insightful book ever written about the United States.
Today, two centuries later, global faith in the US and its leadership is increasingly questioned.
Priddo embarks on a modern road trip following Tocqueville's original route across the country.
The journey features conversations with a wide range of Americans, from high society to prisoners.
The podcast investigates whether Tocqueville's famous guidebook to American democracy is still relevant today.

clips.text: The host explains his plan to retrace the historical path taken by the French aristocrat while meeting various residents.
An inmate reflects on personal decisions and accountability during a prison visit.
A political figure proudly displays a congressional subpoena on their wall.
An individual describes the appalling and unsanitary conditions experienced in a detention cell.
The host questions if the foundational guidebook to the nation remains relevant as the country nears its milestone anniversary.

beschreibung:
When Alexis de Tocqueville visited America from France in 1831 he saw a new kind of society. Not just a country, but an idea that would change the world. His book “Democracy in America” was a big influence on later generations of writers and thinkers, including The Economist’s US Editor John Prideaux. Now, 250 years after its birth, the vitality of that democracy is under question. In this series, John retraces the route Tocqueville took to find out how much of what inspired Tocqueville about America remains—and how worried we should be about what’s changed.
